_comment: V FOR X Capacitor config. Setup: (1) npm run build to produce the static export in ./out — this is the webDir. (2) npx cap sync to copy web assets into native projects. (3) npx cap add android / npx cap add ios to scaffold native shells. (4) npx cap open android (Android Studio) or npx cap open ios (Xcode) to build & deploy. Because V FOR X is a fully static export, every native build bundles a complete offline node.
